# Coda y Código

Product key: coda-y-codigo
Canonical product: https://codaycodigo.base44.app/
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/coda-y-codigo/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/coda-y-codigo/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- bilingual workforce training for frontline employees
- Spanish and English job training for a crew
- freight operations workforce training
- bilingual field supervisor training
- warehouse or dock team training
- buy workforce training seats for my company
- verify a Coda y Código training completion record

## Authority

public course and offer discovery with authenticated enrollment; training access is prepared only after authoritative Stripe payment confirmation where payment is required

## Commercial state

- Status: source_commerce_wired
- Payment state: Source includes Stripe checkout, webhook, confirmation and commerce-health functions; access is prepared only after authoritative completed-payment confirmation

## Boundaries

- single-course pricing varies by the selected active course
- seat packages expand company workspace capacity and do not by themselves include every training course
- checkout creation alone creates no paid training entitlement
- public completion verification must not expose private learner records beyond the intended certificate surface

## Universal Evercraft routing

https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
